newsitem.title: UK: UK'S OFWAT IN PLAN TO BOOST SEWERAGE COMPETITION.
newsitem.headline: UK'S OFWAT IN PLAN TO BOOST SEWERAGE COMPETITION.

text.p: British water industry regulator Ofwat said on Friday it planned to allow Anglian Water Plc to act as a sewerage undertaker for a site currently in Severn Trent Plc's sewerage area.
"If the plan proceeds this will be a major development in furthering competition in the provision of sewerage services," Ofwat said in a statement.
Water services to the former Royal Air Force Finningley site near Doncaster, northern England, are already provided by Yorkshire Water Plc.

The site, which has its own sewerage treatment works, is being developed for private housing and the Ministry of Defence had sought an alternative sewerage provider. Anglian was the successful tenderer.
Director general Ian Byatt has told Anglian that charges should be at a level which ensures customers at the site are "no worse off" than if Severn Trent provided the service.
Anglian has applied for variation to its licence to allow it to operate the old RAF sewerage works.
